integrity: The operator equations, strong condition, automorphism action, and finite-field counts are independently reconstructed from the dual-number multiplication. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies the formulas over four prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The classification is specific to the dual-number algebra and the anti-Rota-Baxter identity of Gao-Liu-Bai.
The motivating source assumes characteristic zero; the positive-characteristic theorem is independently derived from the defining polynomial identity.
A specialized or differently indexed positive-characteristic calculation may contain an equivalent classification.
title: Characteristic-three phase transition for anti-Rota–Baxter operators on the dual numbers
